set.body:
Objective
Correct the semantic alignment of tidy.fmri_lm estimate rows and make the linear-model vignette interpret trustworthy values.

Observed defect
.tidy_fmri_stats creates row-major voxel and term labels but flattens estimate, SE, statistic, and p-value matrices column-major. Existing tests assert only class, columns, and finiteness. The separate runwise structural error remains tracked in bd-01KWA88QJSAMT2Z3A53VEHE6T7.

Acceptance criteria
- For a fixture with at least two terms and three voxels, every tidy row equals the corresponding coef(), standard_error(), and stats() cell.
- Estimates, SEs, statistics, p-values, and inference degrees of freedom share the same orientation.
- Runwise and chunkwise layouts are covered, coordinating with bd-01KWA88QJSAMT2Z3A53VEHE6T7 rather than duplicating its structural-error work.
- a_09_linear_model.Rmd is rerendered and all significance and SE interpretations match corrected output.
- The test fails against the pre-fix column-major implementation.
set.title: Fix tidy.fmri_lm voxel-term alignment with exact-value tests
